subject: Deployed app returns error in leaflet, works fine locally

messages.author: 70451b441e2ad77a
messages.subject: Deployed app returns error in leaflet, works fine locally
parts:
I have an shiny app that uses leaflet and works fine locally. When the app is deployed to shinyapps.io, the app loads but doesn't work. 
I tried to track the problem:

1) Memory is not a problem. The memory usage at metrics is fine.
2) No error messages in the log
3) I am getting the error in the javascript inspector:
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined (leaflet.js:851) 

The part of my code (server) that is returning error:

      leafletProxy("map") %>%
        addPolygons(data = countries[as.numeric(row.names(countries2)),],
                    fillColor = pal2(riskData3), fillOpacity = 0.3,
                    layerId = row.names(countries2),
                    stroke = T, weight = 1, color = pal3(riskData3), opacity = 0.5,
                    popup = polygon_popup2) 

"countries" is a shapefile object created from readOGR (package rgdal). If I remove this part of the code, the deployed app works fine.


The same code (server) has other very similar shapefile object (named "edges") that doesn't need to be removed to work fine in the deployed app:

        leafletProxy("map") %>% 
          addPolygons(data = edges[as.numeric(row.names(edges2)),], weight = 0.5,
                      color = pal0(riskData2), fillOpacity = 0.5, layerId = row.names(edges2))


Any ideas what is happening here? The app is private so I will need to send an authorisation for you.

Thanks a lot
